tenderAddress.blockNumber: Meeting Hall, City Corporation, Royal Circle

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the conditions as per the bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a.The tenderer should be a manufacturer (OEM) who must have manufactured tested and supplied 02 Numbers of minimum 100 TPD Capacity of composting plant and machineries (In a Single Work), However it will be (40%) 01 Number of minimum 100 TPD (In a Single Work) With respect to valid Micro and Small Enterprises of similar type specified in the Schedule of Requirements to any Government dept / ULB / PSU/ or any other Government organizations in any one of the last 3 financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26) and be in satisfactory operation for 12 months as on date of tender opening. (Performance Certificate must be issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer) b.Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer meeting with the above requirement in full can also be considered provided. 1.The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC. 2.The tenderer, as authorized representative should have supplied, commissioned satisfactorily at least 01 Number of minimum 100 TPD Capacity of composting plant and machineries (In a Single Work). Similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements to Government Dept/ ULB/PSU / or any other Government organizations in any one of the last three financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26) (Performance Certificate Must be Issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer)
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both (a) and (b) above, in proforma under Section XII.

The Bidders should have a average annual financial turnover of minimum Rs. 590.00 Lakhs, during the last 3 preceeding Financial Years i.e., (2023-24 to 2025-26). (However, it will be 50% of the estimate cost of the quantity with respect to MSE in the last two preceeding financial years) The Tenderer should submit turnover copy certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN No along with profit & loss statement, Balance Sheet & IT Return File. All such documents reflect the financial situation of the Tenderer, and not sister or parent companies, Financial statements must be audited and certified by a certified Chartered Accountant (CA), Financial statements must be complete, including all notes to the financial statements, Financial statements must correspond to accounting periods already completed and audited (no statements for partial periods shall be requested or accepted).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer/Manufacturer should submit Certificate of registration of the Company under the companies act, 1956 or GST, NSIC registration or any other suitable registration certificate. Issued by Concerned Statutory Authorities under relevant act.

Tenderer offering to supply goods under the contract which the Tenderer did not manufacture of otherwise produce, the Tenderer has been duly authorized (as per authorization form in Section XIII) by the goods manufacturer or produce to supply the goods in India

Tenderer firm/company should not be blacklisted by any government organization. The Tenderer shall furnish an Affidavit (Non judicial Stamp paper of Rs.200)/ for not having Black Listed earlier by the Firm / Company represented by its Proprietor / Partners / Directors / Chairman / Managing Director / Office Bearers in the Business Transactions of any Government /Semi-Government / Government Undertaking / Public Sector Organizations / any other Departments.
The tenderer should furnish details of local Service Centers and information on service support facilitie As per Section XV Support Form

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All the documents as mentioned in technical criteria and bid document
